claims.evidence: Report shows a generic black standing fan with cord; brand and rechargeable battery are not visible.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low
claims.evidence: Battery runtime cannot be observed in still photos.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Age and usage history are not shown in the report.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened
claims.evidence: Motor internals and fault status are not visible in photos.
Documents are not shown in the report.

risks.risk: Fan does not power on or speeds, oscillation, and height adjustment fail
risks.proof: Video of the fan running on cord through all speeds, oscillation, and height adjustment.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or for parts only.

risks.risk: Rechargeable battery is dead, missing, or does not hold charge
risks.proof: Video of the fan running on battery without the power cord.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a corded-only fan with no battery value.

risks.risk: Brand is not Qasa or model is different
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the brand label and model plate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic unbranded standing fan.

risks.risk: Physical damage such as cracked blades, dented grille, rust, broken stand, or missing parts
risks.proof: Close-up photos of blades, grille, stand neck, base, and neck from all angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with visible damage deductions or as damaged.

risks.risk: Age and usage are greater than claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt or purchase date plus close-up of wear on cord, base, and buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used older stock rather than barely used.

risks.risk: Receipt and warranty card are not actually available
risks.proof: Photos of the receipt and warranty card.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without warranty or proof of purchase value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the brand label and model plate
Video of the fan running on battery and on cord through all speeds and oscillation
Photos of the receipt and warranty card
Close-up photos of blades, grille, stand, and base for damage
response.reason: The witness identifies a standing fan, so it can be priced at its worst case; seller claims about Qasa branding, rechargeability, and condition are unproven and reduce value until verified.
